title: HumanSphere support resource registry (official source pointers)
adopter_rules: This registry stores official source pointers, not a live directory. The tool performs no network lookups.
contact_hint repeats only what the official page itself publishes; always confirm on the official page before sharing.
Add or correct entries for your own region before using this Skill Tool with real users.
Never invent a hotline, clinic, shelter, or agency. If no verified entry exists, look the service up with the user.

resources.name: Find A Helpline (international directory of verified helplines)
resources.verify_note: Pick the country and topic, then call the listed line directly.

resources.name: Befrienders Worldwide (emotional support centres by country)
resources.verify_note: Check the centre list for the nearest participating centre.

resources.name: World Health Organization - mental health topic portal
resources.verify_note: Use for plain-language context, not for emergency contact details.

resources.name: Regional poison centre (find via your national health authority)
resources.verify_note: Ask the user's national health authority page for the current poison centre number; do not guess.

resources.name: Philippines - Emergency 911 National Office
resources.verify_note: Dial 911 for police, fire, and medical emergencies; confirm coverage on the official page.

resources.name: Philippines - National Center for Mental Health crisis hotline
resources.verify_note: Read the current hotline numbers published on the NCMH site before sharing them.

resources.name: Philippines - Department of Social Welfare and Development
resources.verify_note: Check the current assistance programmes and field office directory.

resources.name: Philippines - PhilHealth (national health insurance)
resources.verify_note: Confirm membership status, benefit packages, and office hours on the official site.

resources.name: Philippines - Public Attorney's Office (free legal assistance)
resources.verify_note: Confirm eligibility rules and the nearest district office.

resources.name: Philippines - Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas consumer assistance
resources.verify_note: Use the consumer assistance channel for bank disputes and fraud reports.

resources.name: Philippines - National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council
resources.verify_note: Check current advisories, evacuation guidance, and local DRRM office contacts.

resources.name: Philippines - PAGASA weather and flood bulletins
resources.verify_note: Use the current bulletin for local warnings before travel or outdoor plans.

resources.name: United States - 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline
resources.verify_note: Call or text 988; confirm current options and languages on the official page.

resources.name: United States - 211 community services directory
resources.verify_note: Coverage varies by state; confirm the local 211 service area.

resources.name: United Kingdom - NHS 111 urgent medical advice
resources.verify_note: Use 111 for urgent but non-emergency advice; 999 remains the emergency number.

resources.name: United Kingdom - Samaritans
resources.verify_note: Confirm the current free phone number and opening hours on the official page.

resources.name: European Union - 112 emergency number
resources.verify_note: 112 works across the EU; confirm local services and language options.

resources.name: Australia - Lifeline
resources.verify_note: Confirm the current number and text/chat hours on the official page.

resources.name: Australia - healthdirect advice line
resources.verify_note: Confirm current hours; call 000 for emergencies.

resources.name: Canada - 988 Suicide Crisis Helpline
resources.verify_note: Call or text 988; confirm current service languages.

resources.name: India - Tele-MANAS mental health helpline
resources.verify_note: Confirm the current state cell number and languages on the official page.
